definitions.explanation: The current Japanese era name, which began on May 1, 2019 with the enthronement of Emperor Naruhito. It follows the Heisei era.

examples.japanese: {令和|れいわ}の{時代|じだい}が{始|はじ}まった。
{令和|れいわ}に{入|はい}ってから{新|あたら}しい{法律|ほうりつ}ができた。
examples.english: New laws were enacted after the start of the Reiwa era.

examples.japanese: {令和|れいわ}という{元号|げんごう}は{万葉集|まんようしゅう}から{取|と}られたもので、{日本|にほん}の{古典|こてん}に{由来|ゆらい}している。
examples.english: The era name Reiwa was taken from the Man'yōshū, deriving from a Japanese classic.

notes:
{令和|れいわ} is the current Japanese era name ({元号|げんごう}), in use since May 1, 2019.

ETYMOLOGY:
The name comes from the {万葉集|まんようしゅう} (Man'yōshū), Japan's oldest anthology of poetry. It is the first era name derived from a Japanese text rather than a Chinese classic.

ERA SYSTEM:
- {令和|れいわ}{元年|がんねん} = 2019
- {令和|れいわ}2{年|ねん} = 2020
- The era year can be calculated as: Western year − 2018

RELATED WORDS:
- {平成|へいせい}: the preceding era (1989–2019)
- {元号|げんごう}: era name
